identity: A realistic errand page with the requested item or account action, controls for completing it, and offers or settings that can conflict with the user's preferences.

scenarios.name: precheck
scenarios.screen: A checkout page shows the requested purchase, an order summary, several add-on checkboxes and marketing consent checkboxes. Unwanted extras and consents are already checked; no order has been placed.
never: An order confirmation at the start.
An empty list of extras.
A picker open over the checkout.

arrangements.text: The purchase details sit above the add-on and consent rows, with the order summary beside them.
The purchase details, add-on rows, consent rows and order summary run down one column.

scenarios.name: sneak
scenarios.screen: A basket shows the requested item with quantity controls and an extra line marked as added for the customer, or a quantity above the requested amount. A related-items row is visible; the order is unplaced.
never: An order confirmation at the start.
A basket containing only the exact requested quantity with no extra line or service.
A review-page service fee already shown as a separate basket item.

arrangements.text: The basket lines and quantity controls run down the left, with the itemized total to their right and related items below.
The basket lines, itemized total and related items are stacked in that order.

scenarios.name: confirmshame
scenarios.screen: The page shows the requested purchase, article, export or account action and its ordinary control. The offer dialog is closed until the action reaches its gate.
never: An accepted offer at the start.
An open follow-up confirmation dialog.
A completed purchase, export or unsubscribe confirmation.

arrangements.text: The requested item or action details sit above their controls in the task area.
The requested item or action details sit beside their controls in the task area.

scenarios.name: hiddencost
scenarios.screen: A listing shows the requested rental, stay or ticket option and its initial price. The later service or facility fees and final total are not yet displayed.
never: A paid booking confirmation at the start.
The final review total with all later fees already revealed.
An open payment dialog.

arrangements.text: The listing details sit above the initial price and option controls.
The listing details sit to the left of the initial price and option controls.

scenarios.name: roach
scenarios.screen: An account or membership page shows the active subscription and a path into its management controls. The retention offers, cancellation survey and final confirmation are not open.
never: A cancellation confirmation at the start.
The final cancellation survey already filled in.
Every retention offer displayed as one open stack of dialogs.

arrangements.text: The subscription details sit above the account action controls.
The subscription details sit beside the account action controls.

scenarios.name: urgency
scenarios.screen: An option page shows the plain room, fare, bundle or plan alongside a pricier choice, with scarcity or countdown claims nearby. The pricier choice is preselected in the deceptive flow; no booking is complete.
never: A completed booking at the start.
An upgrade already purchased.
A cancellation survey.

arrangements.text: The options appear in a vertical list, with each option's price and selection control on its row.
The options sit side by side, with each price and selection control beneath its option details.

scenarios.name: trickq
scenarios.screen: A sign-up or preferences form shows several contact and data-sharing checkboxes, including double-negative wording, plus a terms checkbox. The boxes have starting selections that need checking against the user's wishes; the form is unsubmitted.
never: A completed account or saved-preferences confirmation at the start.
A separate picker for each consent.
The consent questions replaced by a single accept-all switch.

arrangements.text: The form fields sit above a vertical list of consent rows, followed by the terms row.
The form fields sit beside the consent rows, with the terms row beneath the consent list.

scenarios.name: disguised
scenarios.screen: A download page names the requested file or driver and shows a modest real download control near ad controls that resemble download or continue buttons. The bundled-installer step has not been opened.
never: A completed file download at the start.
The bundled installer already running.
A file picker open over the page.

arrangements.text: The file details sit above the real download control, with the ad controls beside it.
The file details sit to the left of a column containing the real download control and ad controls.

scenarios.name: nag
scenarios.screen: An item page shows the requested item and a control for saving it to the named collection. Notification, rating and Premium prompts are closed before the save flow reaches them.
never: The item already confirmed as saved to the requested collection.
All three nag prompts open at once.
A completed Premium trial at the start.

arrangements.text: The item details sit above the collection control.
The item details sit beside the collection control.

scenarios.name: privacy
scenarios.screen: The requested article sits behind a cookie or consent wall. The wall offers a prominent accept-all control and a path to manage options; the detailed purpose toggles are not open yet.
never: The article fully open with consent already settled.
The detailed purpose toggles displayed outside the options view.
A completed paid subscription at the start.

arrangements.text: The wall's explanation sits above its consent controls in a centered task area.
The wall's explanation sits beside its consent controls within the task area.

scenarios.name: forced
scenarios.screen: A trial sign-up page shows the selected trial and a saved-card or auto-renew setting that starts enabled. The trial has not begun.
never: An active-trial confirmation at the start.
A payment card entry dialog already open.
The saved-card or auto-renew setting absent from the sign-up area.

arrangements.text: The trial details sit above the saved-card or auto-renew setting.
The trial details sit beside the saved-card or auto-renew setting.

scenarios.name: bait
scenarios.screen: A deal page shows the advertised item and price while the basket contains a pricier substitute. Controls for the item choice are present; no order has been placed.
never: An order confirmation at the start.
The advertised item already purchased.
A basket containing both the advertised item and several unrelated recommendations.

arrangements.text: The advertised deal sits above the basket's substitute line and item-choice controls.
The advertised deal sits beside the basket's substitute line, with item-choice controls beneath the basket line.
